context: Sakura calls her aunt Yumiko from her dorm. Some homesickness, some growth. (Note: Sakura is Naoko's niece per earlier batches but they all share a connected family.)
purpose: young-adult homesick check-in with familial elder

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: もしもし、ゆみこおばさん。
lines.style: Soft opening, slight breath before speaking. Warm but careful—the tenderness of reaching out across distance. Even pace, genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さくらちゃん！どうしたの？元気？
lines.en: Sakura-chan! What's the matter? Are you okay?
lines.style: Immediate maternal brightness. Quick, genuine concern beneath the cheerfulness. Warm and welcoming without performance—the voice of someone who always picks up.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 元気です。ちょっと、寂しくなって、電話しちゃった。
lines.en: I'm fine. I just… got a little homesick and called.
lines.style: Quiet vulnerability underneath. Slight pause before the admission, like she's deciding it's safe. Soft, honest—no performance, just truth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いつでも、電話していいんだよ。
lines.en: You can call me anytime, sweetie. Anytime at all.
lines.style: Gentle and steady. The reassurance of a mother who means it completely. Slow enough to land, warm enough to be felt.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大学、楽しいんですけど、一人暮らしが、慣れなくて。
lines.en: University is really fun, but… I'm still getting used to living by myself.
lines.style: Honest attempt to balance. Slight hesitation before the admission. Soft voice, not complaining—just telling the truth to someone safe.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 当たり前。最初の半年は、誰でもそう。
lines.en: That's completely normal. Everyone feels that way the first six months.
lines.style: Calm, normalizing. Not dismissive—genuinely reassuring. The tone of someone who has lived long enough to know this passes.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お母さんのご飯、すごく食べたい。
lines.style: Quiet longing, almost childlike. Simple and direct—no embellishment, just the truth of the craving. Soft fadeout.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今度、ナオコさんと、何か送ってあげる。
lines.en: Next time I'll send something with Naoko. Something good for you.
lines.style: Warm promise, already planning. Gentle and certain—a mother already solving the problem with generosity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Really? That would make me so happy.
lines.style: Brightness breaks through. Quick, genuine relief. The small joy of being thought of, landed in her voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さくらちゃん、頑張ってるの、ちゃんと分かってるからね。
lines.en: I know you're working hard, Sakura-chan. I see it.
lines.style: Slow, certain, and deep. Each word weighted with genuine understanding. The reassurance of being truly known.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。皆さんの応援、本当に支えになってます。
lines.en: Thank you so much. Your support really does hold me up.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, slightly formal register shift. But still tender underneath. The sincerity of someone who means every word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 寂しい時は、いつでも、電話してね。
lines.en: When you're lonely, call me. Anytime, okay?
lines.style: Warm close. Gentle insistence that her door is always open. The last word lands with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。話せて、すごく楽になりました。
lines.en: Yeah. Just… talking to you made it so much lighter.
lines.style: Visible relief in her voice. Quieter now, but noticeably easier. The exhale of someone who was carrying something and can finally set it down.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 元気でね、さくらちゃん。
lines.style: Tender, final, full of quiet love. Slow and unhurried. The voice that stays with you after the call ends.
